candidate.expert_checkpoint_selection: highest clean validation mAP over every epoch, ties choose latest; independent per sensor
candidate.score: sum of supporting sensor confidences / number of available sensors
candidate.box: confidence weighted metric centers/extents and pi periodic yaw

controls: matched seed and 120 epochs: RGB, IR, LiDAR and feature-fusion baseline-v1
compute sensitivity: feature-fusion baseline-v1 with 360 epochs and same checkpoint policy
holdout_policy: Freeze all checkpoint hashes before reading test observations or annotations; no tuning against that test. Historical SF-11 test has already been used for reporting, so independent fresh generated holdout remains desirable for broader generalization.
scope: static synthetic three-class oriented 3D detection; no real-world or unseen-corruption claim
